source_review: Development regression questions generalized from a product-review workflow. Expected body passages were read and their source positions reviewed before changing the evidence filter. No customer records or book text are included. This is not a held-out benchmark.

cases.query: In the full life cycle use case and quantified value proposition, how should a startup account for a customer acquiring, installing, using and maintaining the product, workarounds and the cost of switching?
A pilot evaluation has ended but the customer has not purchased. How should we qualify need, budget, authority, decision process and get concrete next steps?
기업 고객의 파일럿이 끝났지만 구매하지 않았다. 제품에서 AI 답변 생성을 빼고 자료 검색과 선별 기능만 싸게 다시 제안하려 한다. 고객과 구매 과정을 무엇으로 검증해야 하나?
